ios.desc:
Transform your Last.fm and Spotify listening data into beautiful, interactive charts. bijou.fm is an Apple Music scrobbler for Last.fm that automatically syncs your plays in the background, so your listening history stays complete.

AUTOMATIC SCROBBLING
• Seamlessly sync Apple Music plays to Last.fm in the background
• Catch-up scrobbling after restarts or offline periods to reduce missed tracks
• Manual scrobbling for vinyl, radio, and untracked listens
• Full scrobble history with edit and resubmit capabilities
• Also detects non-library tracks!

BEAUTIFUL VISUALIZATIONS
• Explore top artists, tracks, albums, and tags with pie charts, photo grids, and bar charts
• Browse your listening history by year, season, or any custom date range
• Analyze listening habits from gender and nationality perspectives

STAY CONNECTED
• Get notified when your Top 50 charts change or when you hit scrobbling milestones
• Set up chart trackers to monitor position changes
• Home screen widgets in multiple sizes to keep your stats visible

MAKE IT YOURS
• Choose from 10+ color themes inspired by art history and iconic cities—"Picasso," "Tokyo," "Warhol," and more
• Play your charts directly with Spotify Premium or Apple Music
• Compare your taste with friends by overlaying data on their charts

bijou.fm is also available at www.bijou.fm

Read our terms of use at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
